content.message: The change would take the label 'cb000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1' off errand 'aa000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', and it carries processBlocked=true, which keeps every process away from the errand. An ad account cannot take that label off; a service identity can. The labels of the errand were therefore not rebuilt after labels were moved or merged, and it keeps the labels it had.
